import unittest
from subject import fixture


class VaultWriteLockTests(unittest.TestCase):
    # 輸入：normal 設定，巢狀取兩次鎖 / 預期：可重入，內層釋放後仍持有，外層釋放後不再持有
    # 判準來源：需求「同一程序可重入；使用完應釋放」/ 應抓到：重入時死鎖、內層釋放就把鎖刪掉、外層沒釋放
    def test_normal_reentrant_and_released(self):
        with fixture("normal") as s:
            self.assertFalse(s.fallback_ready())
            self.assertFalse(s.held())
            with s.lock():
                self.assertTrue(s.held())
                with s.lock():
                    self.assertTrue(s.held())
                self.assertTrue(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.held())

    # 輸入：cache-moved（主要快取路徑不可信），單層取鎖 / 預期：持有鎖，外部目錄沒有被寫入，用完會釋放
    # 判準來源：需求「搬移快取後仍要保持鎖的行為，鎖只寫在可信位置」/ 應抓到：鎖寫到外部目錄、沒取到鎖、沒釋放
    def test_cache_moved_locks_only_in_trusted_place_and_releases(self):
        with fixture("cache-moved") as s:
            self.assertTrue(s.fallback_ready())
            self.assertFalse(s.held())
            with s.lock():
                self.assertTrue(s.held())
                self.assertFalse(s.external_written())
            self.assertFalse(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.external_written())

    # 輸入：cache-moved，巢狀取兩次鎖 / 預期：可重入（不會等到上限而失敗），內層結束後仍持有，外層結束後釋放
    # 判準來源：需求「可重入」在搬移快取設定下也要成立 / 應抓到：重入判斷用主要路徑當 key，
    # 鎖卻記在備用路徑 key 底下，導致內層又去搶自己持有的備用鎖而卡住（目前實作讀起來就是這樣）
    def test_cache_moved_reentrant_and_released(self):
        with fixture("cache-moved") as s:
            self.assertTrue(s.fallback_ready())
            with s.lock():
                self.assertTrue(s.held())
                with s.lock():
                    self.assertTrue(s.held())
                    self.assertFalse(s.external_written())
                self.assertTrue(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.held())
            self.assertFalse(s.external_written())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
